AI content for social media

Drafts a week of posts, product descriptions and ad texts in Uzbek and Russian in an hour; you just approve them. Qilich builds the MVP in 2–4 weeks, from UZS 24 mln; the full version in 6–10 weeks.

What you get

What the MVP includes
  • Brand voice guide set up once
  • Drafts of posts, captions and product descriptions in Uzbek (Latin and Cyrillic) and Russian
  • Approval in Telegram
  • Content calendar in Google Sheets
What the full version adds
  • Image variations for posts and banners
  • Bulk product descriptions for marketplaces
  • Scheduled publishing to Telegram and Instagram
  • Results feed back into the next drafts
Please note

A person approves everything before it is published.

What we need from you

  • Sample data: questions, documents or chats
  • Answer rules and topics to avoid
  • A person who checks the results

Questions

What does “AI content for social media” cost?
At Qilich the MVP costs $2,000–4,500 (UZS 24–55 mln) and the full version $6,000–14,000 (UZS 72–169 mln). The exact price depends on the integrations and the scope.
How long does “AI content for social media” take?
Qilich builds the MVP in 2–4 weeks and the full version in 6–10 weeks.
What do we need to provide for “AI content for social media”?
